title: Big Island Oasis | KEY.co
description_expanded: This home includes FREE Hilton Waikoloa Village Resort passes in 2026. The Hilton Waikoloa Village Resort was voted #1 resort in Hawaii by USA Today. Normally, resort passes cost $100/adult and $60/child but when staying at this home use for up to 10 people is COMPLIMENTARY with no additional cost each and every day of your stay. This includes use of resort pools, the river pool, waterslides, hot tub, saltwater lagoon for snorkeling, lounge chairs, towels and parking validation for one vehicle. It also includes a 10% discount on Spa Treatments, 10% discount on Lagoon toys and Cabana rentals. Guests love this resort pass which gives them the best of both worlds with hotel privileges and a comfortable, well-equipped vacation home. Discover the ultimate Hawaiian getaway at this luxurious four-bedroom Big Island Oasis within the prestigious KaMilo community. Designed for relaxation and comfort, this home boasts two elegant master suites, each featuring a king-size bed and private ensuite, alongside additional bedrooms furnished with plush queen and twin XL beds. Perfect for families and groups, the open-concept layout invites guests to unwind in the spacious great room, prepare meals in the fully equipped kitchen, and enjoy al fresco dining on the expansive lanai, with a high-end grill and ample seating.
